items.title: Marty Napoleon interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York, New York, January 16, 1999
items.q: We had Pete Condoli with the band, Milt Bernhardt, two brothers, the Brooks brothers... These guys were great.

ctx.x: Well he was probably in a bad mood because Charlie was leaving at the same time, and he said I’ll take it out on you.

Charlie had already left I think. But that band was great. We had a marvelous player. We had a guy named Boots Mussulli, and Boots was my roommate and he would say to me, he had to write an arrangement a week for the band, and he’d say “what do you want me to write?” He didn’t know what to— I’d say “why don’t you do ‘Perdido’?” “Good, I’ll put a solo in there for you.” I’d say of course. He was beautiful. We had Pete Condoli with the band, Milt Bernhardt, two brothers, the Brooks brothers, lead trumpet and lead…
